regime_context: The US thematic detector shows broad positive momentum with 72% of themes eligible, but the leader (Memory, HBM & Storage) is fading, has zero breadth, and low durability, while Cybersecurity, Energy, and Financials display robust trend characteristics under the validated absolute-trend gate. Past desk calls have been unreliable (33% hit rate), so all leans are low conviction.
emerging_watch: Monitor the 'Real Estate' candidate cluster (cohesion 0.689, cohesion_chg 0.235, healthcare/senior housing REITs) for a durable emerging theme; if XLRE extends its uptrend with participation breadth expanding and the cluster cohesion holds above 0.65, it may mature into a rank-eligible theme. theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Despite leading the momentum rank, the theme shows a fading signal (val_state=fading), zero breadth, low durability (0.44), and a mixed HURST tag, suggesting the trend is fragile and may soon fail the absolute-trend gate that historically controls drawdowns. A risk-managed lean is underweight to avoid potential shake-out.
evidence: eligible: true (above trend gate but at risk)
theses.dissent: Memory remains the top-ranked theme by a wide margin and could re-accelerate if new AI-driven demand or supply constraints emerge.

falsifier.text: SMH outperforms SPY by more than 3% total return and the Memory theme maintains a rank of #1 or #2 with durability above 0.5 after 30 trading days.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks #2 with strong trend characteristics: high durability (0.85), trend HURST, and excellent breadth (0.9), while eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate. Heavy crowding (z=1.86) warrants a sizing cap per guardrails, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding may signal a late-stage momentum chase; any negative catalyst could trigger a sharp unwind as participants exit.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SPY by more than 5% total return over the next 30 trading days.

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Energy ranks #4 with robust trend attributes: high durability (0.75), trend HURST, broad participation (0.857), and no crowding, making it a relatively clean trend-following candidate under the absolute-trend discipline that has historically mitigated drawdowns.
theses.dissent: Energy is sensitive to oil price volatility and macro demand concerns; a global growth scare could break the trend quickly.

falsifier.text: XLE underperforms SPY by more than 5% total return by 2026-09-11.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
